phase: search retrieval contracts and graded-evaluation harness
relevance_evidence: none; no graded run has been collected and queries.v1.json is unjudged

suites.name: Elasticsearch retrieval contracts
suites.runtime: disposable elasticsearch:8.15.2 container, unique fixture index, no project volumes
covers: requested price sort honored in every vector-scored mode
RRF candidate union includes vector-only and lexical-only candidates with bounded totals
RRF fuses a duplicate candidate once and paginates one stable union
genuine zero hits stay 200 with retrieval metadata
suites.caveat: hand-constructed deterministic vectors; contract evidence, not semantic relevance

suites.name: search-service unit and API
suites.note: SearchRetrievalElasticsearchTest skips without SEARCH_TEST_ES_ADDRESS; it is run by the script above

suites.name: graded-evaluation harness
covers: hand-computed DCG/IDCG, fixed precision denominator, MRR
unknown labels refused rather than scored as zero; all-zero pools report null NDCG
query schema, provenance, dev/test family split integrity, filter validation
catalog numeric hardening and stale-snapshot cross-checks
response contract, retrieval-metadata and algorithm-downgrade detection
judgment loading: blank/out-of-range grades, provenance, duplicates, pool scope
blinded pool export with retrieval-derived fields stripped
full CLI snapshot -> collect -> pool -> judge -> evaluate/agreement against a stub server
seeded bootstrap determinism and degenerate-kappa nulls
suites.caveat: all labels are synthetic_fixture; the metric values produced are meaningless as relevance

limitations: queries.v1.json is AI-authored and unjudged; no NDCG/recall for any mode has been measured
vector retrieval is exact script scoring, not ANN; RRF totals are candidate-union size
inferred category filters remain active in all modes and can constrain semantic recall
reindex still deletes and recreates the active index; durable/atomic indexing is later work
existing scripts/relevance-results.json remains synthetic catalog-derived regression data
